body:
•  Minecraft Username: Arboklv12
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Prior
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. I don't remember being prior to anyone and if I was, I would like to see some evidence please. I was banned on December 27th 2014 and have waited more than 5 months to be unbanned. I have never appealed for an unban before. I have learned my lesson and won't do it again. I make a very sincere apology.
